SOURCE: assets/ai-generated/2026-08-20-pdrn-skin-repair-serum/run-01/_pdrn_skin_repair_deep_renewal_face_serum_model_applying_with_dropper_4_skingenetix.png, 2048x2048, 2503K PNG. He named a folder of 296 files; 32 were marked, so the pick was his to make and the sheet was built from his own marks rather than a shortlist of mine.

LABEL VERIFIED AT FULL SIZE, AND THIS IS THE PRODUCT LINE WHERE THAT MATTERS MOST. PDRN has previously rendered as PORN — once from the engine, and once purely from Shopify's downscale on a correct master. All six elements are present and correct here: the dotted double-helix mark, the 'Skingenetix' wordmark, 'PDRN SKIN REPAIR', 'DEEP RENEWAL TREATMENT' in pink, 'PREMIUM FORMULA', and '1% (10,000 PPM) PDRN | 30ML'. PDRN is spelled correctly in BOTH places it appears. 30ML is right for the serum. The setting is favourable too: 'PDRN' is set large on this bottle and lands around 42px wide at the 660px render, far above the size at which the previous PORN misread happened. Re-checked at render size after publishing, not just at 100%.

RESOLUTION IS AN UPGRADE. The file it replaces is 1024x1024, which caps the theme's generated srcset at 1000w and serves an upscale to a 2x screen. At 2048 the srcset reaches 2000w.

WHAT IT REPLACES. skingenetix-pdrn-cellular-repair-serum-bottle.jpg, 1024x1024. It stays in Files and simply stops being referenced — nothing is renamed or overwritten, because Langify keys translations off the URL.

MASTER IS SQUARE, which media-with-text requires: the row height is max(text column, image natural height) and .media-with-text__media carries no aspect-ratio of its own, so a non-square master stretches its row and the block stops matching its five siblings. 30 of the 32 marked candidates were square; this is one of them, so no crop was needed. (19 and 20 were not, and would have needed one.)

FILENAME PREFIX CHECKED, NOT JUST COLLISION. There is no file with this exact name, but there IS an existing skingenetix-pdrn-skin-repair-deep-renewal-serum.jpg, which is a strict PREFIX of this one — the shape that once bound two slots to the same uploaded file while polling. Safe in this direction: the uploader polls filename:<stem>* and this stem is the LONGER of the two, so the query cannot match the shorter existing name, and the script prefers an exact stem match before falling back. Verified after upload that the resolved handle is exactly this filename with no suffix.

WEB LOADING. Converted from the 2503K PNG to JPEG q95 4:4:4 progressive with metadata dropped, 1270K — the documented policy in .claude/rules/website-imagery.md rule 5: quality 95 and 4:4:4 so the CDN's WebP pass encodes from a clean picture rather than one already full of JPEG artefacts. Not re-encoded below that; compressing the source was measured on 2026-08-24 and made the site marginally slower. Long edge 2048, inside the 3000px cap and above the 2000w top of this block's srcset. Delivered bytes verified off the CDN after upload, because the CDN is what a visitor downloads.

SEO FILENAME built from the page and the block: brand, 'pdrn' and 'skin repair' and 'deep renewal' from the product and the page, 'serum' as the type, and 'applying dropper' for what is in frame. 68 characters, inside the 80 the uploader warns at.

ALT TEXT describes what is in frame and claims no trial, treatment or result.
